verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents service keys built for AI agent automation and MCP servers. The keys are decoupled from user accounts, and admins can grant full tenant scopes or choose 'Limit access to…' to grant only specific scopes, which is least-privilege, agent-specific credentialing. OAuth-connected assistants are further limited to the connecting member's role, and organization roles can be defined with precise permissions. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of the available scopes and their granularity, documentation of key expiry, rotation or revocation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
